# Agent Skills Setup (skills-repo) Full Documentation

> Agent-first AI coding context & zero-LLM-exposure secret migration Skill across IDEs, CLIs, and computers.

- **Repository**: https://github.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo
- **Author**: Luckycat133
- **Candidate Version**: 0.11.0-dev (unpublished; native client runtime matrix `not-run`)
- **License**: MIT

---

## 1. Architecture & Built-In Profiles

`skills/agent-skills-setup/` ships concise instructions (`SKILL.md`), progressive references (`references/`), templates (`assets/`), and a zero-dependency Python 3.11+ stdlib script (`scripts/migrate_context.py`). It does **not** use proprietary `.acb` bundles, signing keys, SQLite stores, or background daemons, and never claims blanket `100%` runtime certification across IDEs.

| Profile | Skills | Rules / Instructions | MCP Config & Container Key |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cursor** | `.cursor/skills` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `AGENTS.md` | `.cursor/mcp.json` (`mcpServers`) |
| **Claude Code** | `.claude/skills` | `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/rules/*.md` | `.mcp.json`, `~/.claude.json` (`mcpServers`) |
| **Codex** | `.agents/skills` | `AGENTS.md` (`AGENTS.override.md`) | `.codex/config.toml` (`[mcp_servers.<name>]`) |
| **VS Code** | `.github/skills` | `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` | `.vscode/mcp.json` (`servers`) |
| **Copilot CLI** | `.github/skills`, `~/.copilot/skills` | `~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md` | `~/.copilot/mcp-config.json` (`mcpServers`) |
| **Gemini CLI** | `.gemini/skills` | `GEMINI.md` | `.gemini/settings.json` (`mcpServers`, `httpUrl`) |
| **Antigravity / Windsurf** | `.agents/skills`, `.windsurf/skills` | `GEMINI.md`, `.windsurf/rules/*.md` | `mcp_config.json` (`mcpServers`, `serverUrl`) |
| **Cline / Kilo** | `.cline/skills`, `.kilo/skills` | `.clinerules`, `.kilo/rules` | `cline_mcp_settings.json`, `.kilo/mcp.json` |
| **Zed / OpenCode / Pi** | `.agents/skills`, `.opencode/skills`, `.pi/skills` | `AGENTS.md` | `.zed/settings.json` (`context_servers`), `opencode.json` (`mcp`/`mcp.servers`), `.pi/mcp.json` |
| **Kimi / Qwen** | `.kimi-code/skills`, `.qwen/skills` | `AGENTS.md`, `QWEN.md` | `.kimi-code/mcp.json`, `.qwen/settings.json` |

75+ additional clients are routed on demand via `references/products.md` and `migrate_context.py patch-mcp`.

---

## 2. Installation & Usage

```bash
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo.git
cp -R skills-repo/skills/agent-skills-setup /path/to/your-skills-dir/agent-skills-setup
```

### Natural Language Prompts
- *"Migrate Skills, rules, and MCP configs (including API keys) from Cursor in this project to Claude Code and Codex."*
- *"Migrate my Cursor MCP servers to VS Code, redacting secrets into env placeholders."*
- *"I'm changing computers — export my AI coding configs and keys into `~/context-transfer`."*
- *"Restore `~/context-transfer` onto the tools on my new computer."*

---

## 3. Core Safety Invariants

1. **Zero-Context-Leak Out-of-Band Secret Transfer**: `migrate_context.py` moves credentials disk-to-disk in `0600` mode (`0700` dirs/backups), guards Git-tracked files against silent secret writes, and emits only variable names and `sha256[:8]` prefixes on `stdout` / `MIGRATION.md`. `--redact-secrets` converts secrets to placeholders on request.
2. **Preview & Private Rollback Backups**: `--dry-run` makes zero target writes; real runs back up modified files to `~/.agent-skills-setup-backups/` (`0700`/`0600`).
3. **Exclusions & Inactive Untrusted Code**: Chat histories, transcripts, SQLite/LevelDB databases, caches, OAuth cookies, and trust grants are always excluded; hooks remain parked in `.migration-review/` unless `--activate-hooks` is explicitly approved.
